correctness.rationale: Every fixed geometric point has full layer-orbit support and equal pair weights; cross-layer adjacency reduces admissible orbit faces to independent sets of K_n×K_m. Published Proposition 25 supplies ambient H3 rank B and homology concentration, hence trace b, ± dimensions (B±b)/2, and by rational averaging quotient H3. Full finite checks for five cases independently reproduce Lefschetz and mod-2 Betti numbers.
